notes: The Marine Science Center is the Nahant campus housing the Marine and Environmental Sciences department's labs; its own faculty-labs-research entry names no individual PIs (just a facility description). All 'Marine and Environmental Sciences'-tagged labs from the COS faculty-labs-research listing were recorded under northeastern-mes.json instead, since the listing doesn't distinguish MES-department vs. MSC-specific affiliation -- see that file for the actual labs (many, e.g. Katie Lotterhos's lab, are explicitly described as being 'at the Marine Science Center'). Also closely tied to northeastern-csi (Coastal Sustainability Institute), which is headquartered at the MSC.
